mapper.select: select company_id from company where user_id = #{userId} and is_deleted = false
mapper.insert: insert into company_detail ( company_name, company_addr, company_field, company_license, company_as, company_career, company_intro) values ( #{companyName}, #{companyAddr}, #{companyField}, #{companyLicense}, #{companyAs}, #{companyCareer}, #{companyIntro} )
mapper.select: select c.company_id AS companyId, d.company_addr AS companyAddr, d.company_field AS companyField, d.company_license AS companyLicense, d.company_as AS companyAs, d.company_career AS companyCareer from company c join company_detail d ON c.company_detail_id = d.company_detail_id where c.company_id = #{companyId} and c.is_deleted = false

select c.company_id AS companyId, d.company_name AS companyName, d.company_intro AS companyIntro, d.company_addr AS companyAddr, d.company_license AS companyLicense, d.company_field AS companyField, s.avg_total_rate AS companyRate from company c join company_detail d ON c.company_detail_id = d.company_detail_id left join company_score_avg s ON c.company_id = s.company_id where c.company_id = #{companyId} and c.is_deleted = false
